title: How do I ask for leave during a release week?
content: My sister's wedding falls in the same week as our quarterly release. The leave policy says two weeks' notice, which I can give, but the team is stretched. How have you handled this without feeling guilty?

title: Is it normal to need approval for every expense under 20 dollars?
content: Every small reimbursement needs two sign-offs and takes a month. Has anyone changed a policy like this from the inside? What argument worked?

title: How do you make the case for paying down tech debt?
content: Our deploys break every other week because of an old billing module. Product keeps prioritising features. What data convinced your leadership to give time for refactoring?

title: On-call is burning out our smallest team
content: Three engineers share on-call for a service the whole company depends on. Pages at night are common. How did you spread the load or reduce noisy alerts?

title: Code reviews take days. How do we speed them up?
content: Pull requests wait two or three days for review. People are busy, but it slows everyone down. What review habits or rules worked for your team?

title: My manager presents my work as their own
content: In the last two leadership updates, my manager showed the analysis I built without mentioning me. I want credit without starting a fight. How would you raise this?

title: How do I disagree with my director in a meeting?
content: I think a decision is wrong but I am the most junior person in the room. How do you push back respectfully, or should I wait for a one-on-one?

title: Is my salary fair for my level?
content: I found out a new hire at the same level earns noticeably more than me. I have been here three years with good reviews. How should I bring this up with HR?

title: Negotiating a raise when the company says budgets are frozen
content: My review was strong but I was told there is no budget this year. Are there things besides salary worth asking for, like title, equity or training?

title: People stay quiet in retros. How do we fix it?
content: Our retrospectives are polite and useless. Everyone says things went fine, then complains in private. What helped your team speak honestly?

title: I made a big mistake. How do I own it?
content: I deleted a production table by accident. We restored it, but customers noticed. How do I talk about it with the team without being defensive or beating myself up?

title: The offsite felt mandatory fun
content: Our team offsite had drinking games and late nights. Several people felt excluded but nobody said anything. How can we suggest a different kind of offsite?

title: Favouritism in who gets the interesting projects
content: The same two people always get the high-visibility projects. Is it worth raising, and how do I do it without sounding bitter?

title: How do I ask for a promotion to senior engineer?
content: I have been doing senior-level work for a year: leading a project, mentoring two juniors. My manager has not mentioned promotion. How do I start this conversation?

title: Do I need a mentor outside my team?
content: My manager is great but very busy. Did a mentor outside your reporting line help your growth, and how did you find one?

title: Burned out but the project is not done
content: I have worked most weekends for two months. I am exhausted and making mistakes. How do I say I need a break without letting the team down?

title: How do you switch off after work?
content: Slack is on my phone and I keep checking messages at midnight. What boundaries actually worked for you?

title: Meetings across time zones are killing us
content: Half the team is eight hours ahead. Someone always joins at night. How do you run a distributed team without making one side suffer?

title: Return to office: how do I ask to stay remote?
content: The company wants everyone back three days a week. I moved further away during remote work. What should I include in a request to stay remote?

title: A teammate keeps interrupting me
content: In design reviews one colleague talks over me every time. I do not want to make it a big deal. What has worked for you?

title: How do I give hard feedback to a peer?
content: A peer's work often arrives late and incomplete, which blocks me. We are on the same level. How do I raise it kindly but clearly?

title: How do we say no to a feature our biggest customer wants?
content: Our largest customer wants a feature that does not fit the product. Sales is pushing hard. How did you handle this?

title: Designers are brought in too late
content: Engineering starts building before design has a say, then we redo the work. How did your team change the process?

title: Should I tell my manager I am interviewing elsewhere?
content: I have an offer from another company. I like my team but the pay gap is big. Is it smart to tell my manager and ask for a counter-offer?

title: How do I explain a layoff in interviews?
content: I was laid off with a third of the company. Interviewers keep asking why I left. What is a good honest answer?

title: Best way to learn system design on the job?
content: I want to grow into architecture work. Books are fine, but what helped you learn while working: shadowing, design docs, something else?

title: Does a certification help or is it a waste?
content: My company will pay for one cloud certification. Did a certificate change anything for your career?

title: Leaving a big company for an early-stage startup
content: I have an offer from a seed-stage startup: lower salary, some equity. How did you judge whether the startup was a good bet?

title: Co-founders disagree on everything. Is that normal?
content: My co-founder and I argue about every decision, from pricing to hiring. How do founders split decisions without breaking the company?

title: I am the only woman on the engineering team
content: I often feel my ideas are ignored until a male colleague repeats them. How did you handle this, and what can allies do?

title: How can we make meetings fairer for quieter people?
content: Our meetings reward whoever speaks fastest. What practices helped introverts and non-native speakers get heard?

title: Will AI tools replace my analyst job?
content: My company is rolling out an AI assistant that writes SQL and dashboards. As a data analyst, which skills should I build so I stay valuable?

title: How do I convince leadership to trust a machine learning model?
content: Our churn model is accurate, but managers ignore it because they cannot see why it predicts what it does. How did you build trust in a model?

title: My sales target went up 40% with no new leads
content: Leadership raised the quarterly quota but the marketing pipeline is the same. How do I push back on an unrealistic sales target?

title: Marketing and sales keep blaming each other
content: Sales says the leads are bad, marketing says sales never follows up. How did your teams agree on what a good lead is?

title: First-time manager: how do I manage my former peers?
content: I was promoted to team lead and now manage people who were my teammates last month. How do I set boundaries without losing friends?

title: How do I give feedback to someone who is underperforming?
content: One of my direct reports keeps missing deadlines. I have avoided the conversation for weeks. How do you make a one on one about performance useful?

title: How do I say no to my manager without sounding difficult?
content: I already have three priorities and my manager keeps adding more. What words have worked for you to push back politely?

title: I freeze when presenting to senior leaders
content: I know my material, but in front of directors my mind goes blank. How did you get better at public speaking at work?

title: Too many meetings, no time for deep work
content: My calendar has six hours of meetings a day. When do people actually get focused work done, and how do you protect that time?

title: How do you prioritise when everything is urgent?
content: Every request is labelled urgent and every deadline is this week. What system helps you decide what to do first?

title: How do I run a fair technical interview?
content: I am interviewing candidates for the first time. How do you avoid bias and compare candidates fairly on the interview panel?

title: Are take-home assignments fair to candidates?
content: Our recruiter wants a four-hour take home task for every candidate. Is that reasonable, and what do good hiring teams do instead?

title: Is it worth negotiating benefits instead of salary?
content: The offer salary is fixed, but I could ask about health insurance, learning budget or extra leave. Which perks are worth asking for?

title: How do stock options actually work at a startup?
content: My offer includes ESOPs with a four-year vesting schedule. How do I judge whether these stock options are worth anything?

title: Can my employer enforce a non-compete clause?
content: My contract has a one-year non compete and a three-month notice period. I want to join a competitor. What are my rights?

title: What should I ask for if I am laid off?
content: Rumours say a layoff is coming. If it happens, what should I ask about severance, notice pay and references?

title: Is it okay to freelance on the side of a full-time job?
content: I get offers for freelance design work in the evenings. How do I check my contract and keep a side project from becoming a conflict?

title: How do you price freelance consulting work?
content: I am starting as a freelance consultant. Should I charge by the hour, by the day or by the project, and how do I invoice clients?

title: How do I turn an internship into a full-time offer?
content: I start a three-month internship next week. What do interns do that makes managers want to hire them after graduation?

title: My first job is nothing like university
content: As a fresher, I feel lost: no one explains anything and I am afraid to ask. How did you survive the first months of your first job?

title: Returning to work after parental leave
content: I go back next month after six months of maternity leave. How do I handle childcare, guilt and catching up with the team?

title: Caring for an elderly parent while working full time
content: My father needs help most afternoons. How do I ask my employer for flexible hours without risking my career?

title: Is relocating abroad for work worth it?
content: I have an offer that needs a work visa and a move abroad. What did you wish you knew before relocating for a job?

title: My company wants me to transfer to another city
content: They offered a transfer to the new office with a small relocation package. What should I negotiate before I agree?

title: Imposter syndrome after a promotion
content: Since my promotion I feel anxious every day that people will find out I do not deserve it. How did you deal with imposter syndrome?

title: Is it safe to tell my manager about anxiety?
content: My anxiety has been bad and it affects my work. Should I tell my manager, use the employee assistance programme, or keep it private?

title: How do you handle an angry customer every day?
content: I work in customer support and get abusive calls daily. How do you stay calm, and when should a complaint be escalated?

title: Our support team is drowning in tickets
content: Ticket volume doubled but the support team did not grow. How did you make the case for more helpdesk staff?

title: How much of my salary should I save and invest?
content: I just got my first proper job. How do you split income between savings, investing and fun, and when do you start a retirement fund?

title: How do I plan income tax with a new job?
content: Switching jobs mid-year confused my taxes. What should I ask HR and what documents do I need for income tax?
